theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Euclid P) ℝ), μHE[n] M ≠ ∞ → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q → MeasurableSet U → (∀ y, 0 ≤ f y) → (∀ y ∈ U, 1 ≤ f y) → ∀ t : ℝ≥0∞, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in (Q : Set (Euclid P)), f y ∂μHE[n]) < t → ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), μHE[n] (M ∩ Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r ⁻¹' U) ≤ t * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n)
